nodes.summary: If the RSS has a feasible minimizer with `p ≥ 2` archetypes, it has one with every archetype on the boundary of the convex hull of the data.
nodes.title: Existence of an archetype minimizer on the hull boundary

nodes.summary: Cutler–Breiman Proposition 1(ii): for at least two archetypes, any feasible archetypes can be replaced by feasible archetypes on the boundary of the convex hull of the data whose convex hull contains the original one; in particular the RSS does not increase.
nodes.title: Feasible archetypes can be moved to the boundary of the hull

nodes.summary: Archetypes are feasible if each is a mixture of the data points.
nodes.title: Feasible archetypes

nodes.summary: The sample mean of the data.
nodes.title: Sample mean of the data

nodes.summary: Cutler–Breiman Proposition 1(i): with a single archetype, the sample mean is feasible and minimizes the RSS.
nodes.title: The sample mean is the optimal single archetype

nodes.summary: Cutler–Breiman Proposition 1(iii): if every data point is a mixture of the archetypes, the RSS vanishes. Requires `0 < p`: for `p = 0` the hull is empty, so `rss` is `0` vacuously and the vanishing would not witness a fit.
nodes.title: The RSS vanishes when the archetypes' convex hull contains the data

nodes.summary: The residual sum of squares of archetypes `z` for the data `x`: each data point is replaced by the closest point of the convex hull of the archetypes. This is only meaningful for `0 < p`: for `p = 0` the hull is empty and `infDist` to the empty set is `0` by convention, so `rss` is `0` vacuously and must not be read as a perfect fit.
nodes.title: Residual sum of squares in archetypal analysis

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
